correctness.rationale: The proof reconstructs the exact gauge, Gaussian variables, unique-maximum decomposition, quantifiers and parameter range. The packaged numerical check verifies only coefficient arithmetic and is not used as proof.

Statement-level searches over the truncation, its exact gauge, the half-normal maximum formulation, and the leading coefficient found no equivalent or stronger result. The derivation is independent of search absence and reconstructs the coefficient from the exact Gaussian integral.
